title: W021.5 Stage A Post-W021 Architecture & National Data-Truth Audit
governance: Master Execution Framework Amendment v1.2 / Rule IV-001 (Non-Self-Acceptance)

executiveSummary.auditScope: Stage A post-W021 architecture and national data-truth audit across all 18 canonical domains. Stages B through I are strictly unexecuted and not authorized under Directive 114.
executiveSummary.bifurcatedArchitectureDiagnosis: The repository exhibits a profound structural bifurcation: (1) A robust, highly normalized relational PostgreSQL core established in W014-W021 (Migrations 039-057) supporting canonical entities, temporal tenures, contest candidacies, PostGIS vector tiles, and an authenticated Fastify SaaS gateway (/api/vsaas/v1/...); and (2) A legacy Sprint 1-30 in-memory seed layer consisting of flat TypeScript data files (>25MB), flat GeoJSON, and single-table mutable models (Migration 012) using fragile fallback chains ('winner2025 ?? winner2024 ?? winner2023 ...').
executiveSummary.nationalCoverageReality: Constituency geographic boundaries, names, and seat counts exist for all 31 States and Union Territories (4,123 Assembly Constituencies and 543 Parliamentary Constituencies). However, deep political intelligence (politician profiles, tenures, defect history, demographic breakdowns, margin data) is currently populated almost exclusively for Telangana (TS), with partial stubs for 7 other major states (AP, KA, MH, TN, KL, WB, UP), and zero deep records for the remaining 23 states/UTs.
executiveSummary.externalScraperIndependence: Scrapers in scrapers/ (MyNeta, Wikipedia) are historical, offline, unversioned batch extraction utilities with zero automated cron execution or live database connection. The platform has zero scheduled continuous background data ingestion crons.
executiveSummary.delimitationEngineSeparation: The authoritative delimitation math engine (Hamilton apportionment, Article 332 SC/ST allocation, Article 82/170 legal applicability) is centralized in apps/api/src/services/delimitationService.ts. However, the mobile client (apps/mobile/stores/delimitation.ts) contains an obsolete, duplicated simulator with static constants (119, 543) that must be decommissioned in favor of the Fastify API.

phase1_ciRemediationAudit.rootCauseAnalysis: Forensic audit of package.json revealed line 297 explicitly declared lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc: ^1.32.0 in root dependencies. This forced npm ci on Linux runners to treat a platform-specific Windows MSVC binary as a mandatory dependency rather than an optional platform package, failing closed across all four CI jobs.
phase1_ciRemediationAudit.remediationAction: Removed lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc from root package.json line 297. Regenerated package-lock.json using npm install --package-lock-only, ensuring lightningcss-win32-x64-msvc is marked optional: true exclusively under lightningcss.optionalDependencies without --force or --legacy-peer-deps. Hardened EXECUTION_STATE.md governance fields (IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZATION: NO, IMPLEMENTATION_AUTHORIZATION_COMMIT: NONE).

governance.failureRootCause: Downstream step failure unrelated to dependencies: actions/checkout@v4 runs with default fetch-depth: 1 (shallow clone), causing git log -n 1 --format='%h' 795b9af -- AMENDMENT_v1.5.md to fail with 'fatal: bad revision 795b9af'.

stateDataService.fallbackChainAnalysis: Lines 57-58: let currentParty = c.winner2025 ?? c.winner2024 ?? c.winner2023 ?? c.winner2022 ?? c.winner2021 ?? c.winner ?? ''; let currentMLA = c.winnerName2025 ?? c.winnerName2024 ?? c.winnerName2023 ?? c.winnerName2022 ?? c.winnerName2021 ?? c.winnerName ?? '';. This pattern masks whether a candidate actually contested in a given year.
stateDataService.byElectionOverrides: Lines 60-76 contain procedural hardcoding for 5 specific seats (TN AC 35/101, WB AC 210/70, PY AC 9). These overrides demonstrate genuine data truth but must be modeled relationally in election_contests rather than procedural shims.
stateDataService.stateSpecificCoupling: Lines 196-208 leak getTSRawSeeds(), getTSElectionHistory(), getTSMLAProfiles(), and getMLAProfile into a common service. Lines 338-463 contain hardcoded branching for 8 states (TS, AP, KA, MH, TN, KL, WB, UP) while silently emitting zero historical results for the remaining 23 states.

delimitationSubsystem.mathematicalCore: Hamilton largest-remainder method with strict quota safety (MAX_SAFE_REQUESTED_SEATS = 10000). Proportional Article 332 SC/ST reservation logic mathematically decoupled from allocation remainder assignment.
delimitationSubsystem.statutoryBaselines: Byte-exact legal chain: 2008 ECI Delimitation Order -> APRA 2014 -> G.S.R. 311(E) (2015) -> ECI Notification 282/AP/2018(DEL) -> Current geography.
delimitationSubsystem.residueFound: getMlaImpact (line 1327) explicitly aborts for any stateCode !== 'TS'. Lines 1344-1360 contain manual benchmark injections for Kodangal (AC-065, margin 32532) and Gajwel (AC-040, margin 45031).
delimitationSubsystem.mobileStoreDuplication: apps/mobile/stores/delimitation.ts contains client-side simulation logic and hardcoded seat counts, conflicting with the single-source-of-truth Fastify API.

aiIntelligenceSubsystem.systemPromptScope: Hardcoded exclusively to Telangana (119 seats, 2023 election results: INC 64, BRS 39, BJP 8, AIMIM 7).
aiIntelligenceSubsystem.contextBuilderScope: buildConstituencyContext (lines 49-98) only queries TELANGANA_CONSTITUENCIES, getConstituencyHistory, getMLAProfile, getConstituencyDemographics, and getConstituencyTimeline. Does not accept or resolve any other state.
